title: Adding a nonnegative integer to a normalized difference, at the representation level
statement: For naturals a, b and c, subNatNat(a, b) + c = subNatNat(a + c, b).

formal.statement: theorem Int.subNatNat_add_ofNat : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} Int (Int.add (Int.subNatNat x0 x1) (Int.ofNat x2)) (Int.subNatNat (AxNat.add x0 x2) x1))))
